Container.Name: reauth-bot
Container.Overview: Standalone Schwab trusted-device re-consent bot (repo: github.com/texasdaddy/reauth-bot). Self-contained image; on a ~96h cadence it drives a target service's login flow inside a persistent trusted-device profile (skips 2FA) so the Schwab 7-day consent refreshes itself. This template targets Tape; LOGIN_URL/TOKEN_URL have no default and must be set at creation. REQUIRES a one-time interactive trusted-device seed: set SEED_MODE=1 + SEED_VNC_PASSWORD, Apply, complete the consent over noVNC (http://CONTAINER-IP:6080/vnc.html), then clear SEED_MODE and Apply. The trusted-device cookie MUST persist across updates (Profile volume). Alerting follows the fleet standard: set ALERT_NTFY_URL to the FULL topic URL and mount the shared alerting config read-only at /kw_shared; each run reports OK/ERROR to both email and ntfy. See the reauth-bot repo README.
Container.Description: Standalone Schwab trusted-device re-consent bot (github.com/texasdaddy/reauth-bot). Self-contained image; UI-deployed; one-time seed via SEED_MODE. This template targets Tape.

Config.Name: Profile
Config.Description: Trusted-device browser profile + /profile/shots debug captures. REQUIRED - an absolute path on a POOL. It MUST survive updates and reboots: losing it forces the manual interactive re-seed.

Config.Name: SCHWAB_USER
Config.Description: Schwab login id (drives the trusted-device browser login)

Config.Name: SCHWAB_PASS
Config.Description: Schwab password

Config.Name: LOGIN_URL
Config.Description: The service's login endpoint the bot navigates to start consent — e.g. https://tape.your-domain.example/v1/admin/login

Config.Name: TOKEN_URL
Config.Description: Set at creation. The target service's token-status endpoint the bot reads (plain HTTP GET) to confirm consent advanced. Use the service's DIRECT/internal URL (its container IP:port) — NOT a public CDN host (Cloudflare 403s non-browser requests). Format: http://SERVICE-IP:PORT/v1/admin/token

Config.Name: CALLBACK_URL_MATCH
Config.Description: Optional: substring of the post-consent redirect back to the service (blank = image default /v1/admin/callback)

Config.Name: TOKEN_ISSUED_FIELD
Config.Description: Optional: the monotonic consent field in TOKEN_URL's JSON (blank = image default refresh_issued_at)

Config.Name: Shared alerting config
Config.Description: READ-ONLY mount of the shared config directory. Set the host path to the directory holding configs/alerting.env (EMAIL_TO, EMAIL_FROM, SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASSWORD). Without it the email channel is skipped and only ntfy alerts.

Config.Name: ALERT_NTFY_URL
Config.Description: This service's own ntfy topic as a FULL URL — https://ntfy.example.com/your-topic. A bare topic is refused: every push would die with 'unknown url type'. Blank = no ntfy channel (the bot warns at boot if that leaves it with no channel at all).

Config.Name: ALERT_SELFTEST
Config.Description: Set to 1 and Apply to send ONE test notification on the next start (proves email + ntfy without waiting for a reauth cycle), then clear it. Blank = off.

Config.Name: REAUTH_INTERVAL_HOURS
Config.Description: Refresh cadence in hours (~4d; ≥1 retry of margin before the 7-day Schwab wall). The bot also SKIPS the reauth on startup if the consent is already fresh, so a restart never adds a redundant one.

Config.Name: REAUTH_RETRY_HOURS
Config.Description: Retry interval after a failed run, in hours

Config.Name: SEED_MODE
Config.Description: Set to 1 ONLY for the one-time interactive seed (headed browser over noVNC on :6080); blank = headless steady state

Config.Name: SEED_VNC_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Required when SEED_MODE=1 — VNC password gating noVNC (the seed is a live brokerage login on br0). Blank refuses to start in seed mode.

Config.Name: REAUTH_SEED_HOLD_SECONDS
Config.Description: How long (s) the seed keeps the headed browser open for you to log in + approve 2FA. Raise if a slow SMS 2FA risks closing it mid-login.

Config.Name: Seed noVNC
Config.Description: noVNC port, used ONLY during the seed (SEED_MODE=1). Reach it at http://SERVER-OR-CONTAINER-IP:6080/vnc.html (on bridge it's the host IP; on br0 the container IP).

Config.Name: SEL_USER
Config.Description: Optional: username field CSS selector (blank = default #loginIdInput)

Config.Name: SEL_PASS
Config.Description: Optional: password field selector (blank = #passwordInput)

Config.Name: SEL_SUBMIT
Config.Description: Optional: submit button selector (blank = #btnLogin)

Config.Name: SEL_CONSENT
Config.Description: Optional: consent/allow button selector list (blank = image default)

Config.Name: SEL_2FA
Config.Description: Optional: selector(s) detecting a re-appeared 2FA prompt (blank = image default). Gates the 're-seed required' alarm.
